gaps.explanation: Statement transfers_out 193,930 = p4 Total Governmental Funds column (193,930) on the Transfers in row, i.e. the NET transfer to the utilities after the Eliminations column (243,930 in / out). Detail has no transfers out because the General and Sales Tax columns on p4 were never added (the only governmental detail transfer is Rescue +6,534 from p10, printed positive under Transfers out, an inflow). Missing p4 fund-column transfers: General Transfers in 50,000 and Transfers out (200,464); Sales Tax Transfers out (50,000). After adding, gross transfers out = 200,464 + 50,000 = 250,464 vs statement 193,930; the remaining 56,534 is different basis only (detail gross per fund, statement net): gross transfers in General 50,000 + Rescue 6,534 = 56,534, and 250,464 - 56,534 = 193,930 exactly (= p6 utility transfers in, Water 194,930 - Sewer 1,000). So the fund-column lines below complete detail; the leftover is the gross-vs-net basis difference.
